---
name: cert-rotation
description: Rotates the staging TLS certificates by the team runbook. Use when the user asks to rotate, renew or replace a staging certificate. Not for production certificates.
---

# Cert rotation

1. Check the expiry with `openssl x509 -enddate -noout -in <cert>`.
2. Request the new certificate from the internal CA.
3. Replace the file and reload the proxy.
